notes.title: Full Version / DLC now available!
notes.content:
Just wanted to post a quick note to let folks know the full version / DLC is available now (apologies it wasn't earlier). So if you want to try out the other 5 battles, the achievements,  trading cards etc go check it out!
* [url=store.steampowered.com/app/676080/Super_POTUS_Trump_The_Full_Game/]Super POTUS Trump: The Full Game! (DLC)[/url] *

Thanks to everyone for the great reviews already! Great to hear people dig it. 

#MAGA!
